gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.118: Go too long without food or water and the edges of your sight start to darken. Leave it any longer and you may black out wherever you are, so eat and drink before it gets that far.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.soft.0: There you are, %1$s. Your lips are cracked right through... when did you last have a drink?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.soft.1: Easy now, easy. You're as dry as old parchment, love. Water, maybe?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.soft.2: Oh, thank goodness you're awake. You feel parched to me. Have you had any water today?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.plain.0: Up you get, %1$s. Your mouth's like sand, I'd wager.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.plain.1: You went down hard. When did you last drink anything?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.plain.2: Awake? Good. You look dry as a bone.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.hard.0: On your feet, %1$s. And find a well, by the look of you.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.hard.1: Lying in the road like a drunk. Only you've had nothing to drink, have you?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.thirst.hard.2: Get up. You're dry as dust and twice as useful.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.soft.0: There you are, %1$s. You're white as a sheet... when did you last eat something?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.soft.1: Easy, easy. I can hear your belly from here, dear.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.soft.2: Oh, you gave me a fright. You're all skin and bone. Have you eaten today?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.plain.0: Up you get, %1$s. You look like you've not eaten in days.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.plain.1: You went down hard. Your stomach's growling like a dog.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.plain.2: Awake? Good. You're pale. Eaten anything lately?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.hard.0: On your feet, %1$s. And put some food in you before you fall again.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.hard.1: Lying in the dirt like a sack of turnips. Only you've not eaten a turnip in a while, have you?
faint.jaymoskingdoms.hint.hunger.hard.2: Get up. Starving yourself won't make you any lighter on your feet.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.soft.0: You fainted, %1$s, you're parched half to death. Here, drink from mine, slowly now.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.soft.1: You collapsed from thirst, poor thing. Take my waterskin. Small sips.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.soft.2: You dropped right where you stood. It's the thirst. Here, drink, please.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.plain.0: You passed out, %1$s. Thirst does that. Here, have some of mine.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.plain.1: You fainted for want of water. Take a drink, then go find a well.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.plain.2: Thirst knocked you flat. Here. Drink.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.hard.0: You fainted from thirst, %1$s. Fool. Here, drink, and don't make me do this again.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.hard.1: Dropped like a stone for want of water. Drink this before you die on my doorstep.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.thirst.hard.2: Thirst put you on your face. Take it. Drink.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.soft.0: You fainted, %1$s, you're starving. Here, eat this, it's all I have on me.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.soft.1: You collapsed from hunger, poor thing. Take a bite of mine, go on.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.soft.2: You dropped where you stood. You need food. Here, eat.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.plain.0: You passed out, %1$s. Hunger'll do that. Here, have a bite.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.plain.1: You fainted for want of food. Eat this, then find a proper meal.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.plain.2: Hunger knocked you flat. Here. Eat.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.hard.0: You fainted from hunger, %1$s. Fool. Eat this and don't make me do it again.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.hard.1: Dropped like a stone for want of food. Eat this before you die on my doorstep.
faint.jaymoskingdoms.tell.hunger.hard.2: Hunger put you on your face. Take it. Eat.
